title: Longest Subarray with Equal 0s and 1s
statement:
Given a binary array (containing only 0s and 1s), find the length of the longest contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0s and 1s.

Use the prefix-sum trick: replace each 0 with -1, then find the longest subarray with sum 0.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (0 or 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest subarray with equal 0s and 1s.

examples.explanation: The entire array has one 0 and one 1.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: replace 0 with -1; find longest subarray with prefix sum = 0
